rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who is naturally reserved and not inclined to interact.

example.english: He is withdrawn and rarely speaks at gatherings.
example.traditional: 佢平時好內向，去到聚會都唔多出聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ping4 si4 hou2 noi6 hoeng3 heoi3 dou3 zeoi6 wui6 dou1 m4 do1 ceot1 seng1

rows.note: Use this when the person's withdrawn behavior is specifically due to shyness or embarrassment.

example.english: My little sister is withdrawn and hides behind me when she sees strangers.
example.traditional: 我個妹好怕醜，見到生人就匿喺我後面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 mui6 hou2 paa3 cau2 gin3 dou2 saang1 jan4 zau6 nei1 hai2 ngo5 hau6 min6

rows.note: Use this for a book or other item that has been taken back and removed from circulation.

example.english: The publisher has withdrawn this book because some of its content caused problems.
example.traditional: 呢本書有啲內容出咗問題，出版社已經收回晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 jau5 di1 noi6 jung4 ceot1 zo2 man6 tai4 ceot1 baan2 se5 ji5 ging1 sau1 wui4 saai3
